source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the if-else statement (PDF 42).

blocks.text: if-else statement mein do raaste hote hain: condition (shart) True ho to pehla block chalta hai, False ho to else wala block.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan bhi "If condition:" bare I se chhapti hai; sahi if condition: hai.
temperature = 15 hai, to temperature > 30 False hai aur else wala block chalta hai: "It’s not a hot day " print hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Class activity: number juft (even) ya taaq (odd) hai, check karne ka if-else statement likhein.
blocks.explanation: 2 se divide karne par bachne wala baqi (remainder) dekhein: if num % 2 == 0: print("Even") else: print("Odd").

items: if-else: condition True ho to if block, False ho to else block; sirf ek chalta hai.
